decisions.decision: Phase 3 design goes through the expert panel, not a single specialist
decisions.rationale: Owner routes core/architecture decisions to the panel (established pattern). _activity_fact pushdown has genuine spread: running-max windowing, stream-row memory/chunking, and a contract revision.

decisions.decision: GUIDING PRINCIPLE (owner): push maximum computation OUT of Python and INTO DuckDB (SQL + window functions). Python = orchestration only; the DB does the heavy lifting (it is an analytical/columnar engine).
decisions.rationale: Per-statement latency is the cost, not data volume; SQL set-ops beat per-row Python round-trips on a columnar engine.

decisions.decision: MANDATORY TENSION the panel must resolve, not skip: this revises the VALIDATED Phase-10 decision (metrics.py is pure, storage-free, unit-testable without a DB, enforced by an AST import-boundary guard). Moving calc_hr_recovery / calc_vertical_speed / calc_cardiac_drift into SQL changes that contract. Weigh what's lost: DB-free unit-testability of metric math, portability, and the AST guard's meaning.
decisions.rationale: Owner explicitly flagged it; PROJECT.md Key Decisions logs Phase-10 as validated. Silent contradiction would be a regression.

decisions.decision: Byte-parity with current materialized facts is a hard gate
decisions.rationale: Template exists: tests/test_read_model_materialization.py::test_materialize_batched_fact_upserts_match_sequential dumps all 4 fact tables; the Phase-2 method-level parity test (test_daily_fact_sums_between_matches_per_day_reads) is the other pattern.

context_notes: Throughline of the whole sweep: DuckDB has high per-STATEMENT latency (~2-4ms; analytical not OLTP), so per-row read/write-in-loop is the recurring anti-pattern. We fixed writes (streams f7bec8b, materializer facts 99dad87) and the per-day daily READS (89603c1). The LAST big lever on the full fingerprint-driven recompute is _activity_fact's per-activity read fan-out: 10 queries x all activities (~thousands) ~= tens of thousands of statements. The user-facing MCP read path is already clean (materialized read model = bulk reads + Python transform). Phase 3 is bigger/riskier than Phase 2 because it touches metric computation data-flow and the Phase-10 purity contract. No pandas/pyarrow installed (DuckDB columnar bulk-ingest via Arrow unavailable without a new dep) — relevant if the panel proposes Arrow round-trips. Profile method: pytest --durations + cProfile by tottime (cProfile inflates import machinery ~8x; trust _duckdb.execute C-time + statement COUNTS). Verify all panel/agent findings against code before acting (leads, not facts).
